title: Finite-sample uncertainty for retention estimates
statement: Develop influence-function or bootstrap confidence intervals for reported retention functionals (e.g. geometric-mean retention), handling the non-smoothness of hard assignment at cell boundaries, so retention is reported with error bars rather than as a point estimate. Settled special case (5 Sep 2026, RETENTION-PLUGIN-CLT-FROZEN-SCALAR): frozen rule, scalar true score, iid equally weighted oracle-score evaluation sample - the plug-in ratio is asymptotically normal with a consistent influence-function variance and a valid Wald interval whenever sigma^2 > 0. Still open: vector scores and the geometric-mean retention (det R)^(1/d) as a matrix functional of the same moments; rules refitted on the evaluation sample, where the boundary non-smoothness enters; weighted samples; and any uncertainty statement without an oracle score.
